title: dogfood: two CONTROL cases in `wall-environment-metadata-refusal.dogfood.test.ts` read a refused `publish-drafts` (200, `success: false`, `list-view-object-outside-closure`) as a write, so they measure nothing at that door
body:
Filing gate **①: a defect with a named locus and a measured reproduction** (a false green: a CONTROL that cannot fail at the door it claims to measure). Reader who acts: the `domain:cli` seat (`packages/qa`), triage first for the grade. Filed by `domain:cli` seat 2 (#22648) · `os-justin` · session `session_01LmjU2x1faLZ39DVTFyVca6`, from the Acceptance notes of PR #24724 (#24700). That dispatch held these cases off, so they are not changed there. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Measured (by #24700's dev on the PR's head `70fe76cd6`, instrumented run R5, restored hash-equal to `HEAD`)

`packages/qa/dogfood/test/wall-environment-metadata-refusal.dogfood.test.ts` has two cases outside the one PR #24724 fixes:
- the walled `CONTROL: the platform operator writes at every one of these doors`;
- the `single (CONTROL)` case.

Each publishes a draft list view bound to `crm_lead` into a package that declares no dependency on the CRM package. Since PR #24630 (`9f12d06770`, the ruled closure narrowing), each of those three publishes answers `200` with `success: false, outcome: refused, publishedCount: 0` and `list-view-object-outside-closure`:
- `crm_lead.em_iso_pkgv` into `com.em.iso.opctl`;
- `crm_lead.em_gro_pkgv` into `com.em.gro.opctl`;
- `crm_lead.em_sin_pv` into `com.em.sin.a`.

The cases' `ok()` reads only the status, so each reads a refused publish as "the operator writes" (walled) or "writes as before" (`single`). These CONTROLs therefore measure nothing at the `publish-drafts` door, and they stay green whether or not that door admits the operator.

## Shape (PR #24724's, not decided here)

- The package each case creates declares `dependencies: { 'com.example.crm': '*' }` at `POST /packages`. `com.example.crm` is `examples/app-crm`'s `manifest.id`, and the file names it `CRM_PKG` after PR #24724.
- Each publish line asserts the receipt in `data` (`success: true`, `outcome: 'published'`, `publishedCount`), with `failed[]` as the assertion message.
- The view names stay on `crm_lead`, so no downstream line changes. ⛔ No change to the narrowing.

**Serial:** same file as PR #24724, so this is dispatched after that PR lands.
